description:
Get attachments list for a given contact from Holded.

Args:
  - contact_id (string): The contact ID to list attachments for (required)
  - response_format ('json' | 'markdown'): Output format (default: 'json')

Returns:
  Array of attachment file names.

contact_id.description: The contact ID to list attachments for

response_format.description: Output format: 'json' for structured data or 'markdown' for human-readable

name: holded_invoicing_list_contact_attachments
title: List Holded Contact Attachments
